segments.prompt: Head tilted down, she slowly lowers the small black compact digital camera into the open woven mouth BEHIND the flat leather flap of the tote hanging from the crook of her elbow, the camera disappears inside, then she lifts her head to look out at the water. The tote keeps its exact design: woven natural straw body, caramel leather flap and trim, exactly two rolled handles, two crossed belt straps on the front face only, the back face is plain woven straw, no duplicated front detailing on any other face, no zippers on the bag, no metal hardware. The leather flap stays ONE connected piece folded all the way over, lying completely flat on the front the entire clip, never lifting, never splitting, never opening a gap between its sections. Contents go into and out of the woven mouth behind the flap, never through it. Ambient sound only, no speech, no voiceover. No cuts. No zooms. No transitions. Raw handheld iPhone footage, subtle natural hand shake, UGC aesthetic. Vertical 9:16. No on-screen text of any kind. ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT
